summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Put Your A.I. Agents to Work with These 5 Killer Tasks
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Trust Is Not What It Seems — And Fraudsters Are Counting on It
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 9 articles published in the last 24 hours
